title: Users
description: The customer accounts. Deleted ones stay listed, and the Deleted column is what says so.

password.label: Initial password
password.description: Hand this over out of band and ask them to change it. Nothing forces a change at first sign-in.

create.title: New user
create.description: They can sign in as soon as this is saved.

edit.title: Edit {{email}}
edit.description: Email is not editable — changing the identifier a session was established with is its own flow.

delete.title: Delete {{email}}?
delete.description: The account is kept and marked deleted, and every session ends. It cannot sign in, and admin edits are refused. The email address becomes available to register again — there is no undo.

bulkDelete.description: Each account is kept and marked deleted, and every session ends. They cannot sign in, and admin edits are refused. Their email addresses become available to register again — there is no undo. An account that is already deleted will be refused, and you will be told which.

revokeSessions.title: Sign {{email}} out everywhere?
revokeSessions.description: Every session of this account ends immediately. The account itself is unchanged and they can sign in again.

resetPassword.title: Reset the password for {{email}}
resetPassword.description: They stay signed out until they use the new password. Nothing forces them to change it afterwards.

password.label: New password
password.description: Hand it over out of band. Every session of this account is signed out.

currentPassword.label: Your own current password
currentPassword.description: Confirms it is you making the change, not a stolen session.

outcomes.passwordReset: The password was reset and every session of that account was signed out.
outcomes.sessionsRevoked: Every session of that account was signed out.
